# Reuters' The Insurer TV speaks with David Perla about the symbiosis between legal finance and insurance


- Risk management & insurance


January 28, 2026


-
-
-
-


Legal financiers and insurers are not “natural opponents," says Burford Vice Chair[David Perla](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/david-perla/) .


In conversation with Reuters’ *The Insurer TV* , David Perla addresses common misconceptions about the relationship between the two industries and offers perspective on how legal finance and insurance fit within the broader disputes ecosystem—an interaction that is often misunderstood.


Watch[here](https://www.theinsurer.com/tv/news-in-focus/legal-financers-and-insurers-are-not-natural-opponents-says-burford-capitals-2026-01-28/) .
